Clients._comment: G8 (garbati-platform T-038): dedicated client for OpsApi, used by the combined docker-compose stack - additive only, dev-demo-driver above is untouched. KeyHash is SHA256(ApiKey) where ApiKey is the exact literal string already sitting in Garbati.OpsApi's own DownstreamServices:OrchestratorApi:ApiKey placeholder.

DownstreamServices._comment: Resolved by garbati-platform T-038's docker-compose stack: IdentityApi and LedgerApi each now define a 'compose-orchestrator' client matching the exact ApiKey strings below, so these DO authenticate when run via docker-compose (the stack also overrides BaseUrl to each service's container name, since 'localhost' only makes sense when every service runs directly on the host). Running each service individually via 'dotnet run' instead of compose still needs real keys issued by each sibling - see each one's own README.
